edges.reason: _msgSender() returns msg.sender from the Context base contract.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the token transfer.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender when spending allowance.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
manualswap authorises only _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1, a weak hardcoded-address check.
openTrading is gated by onlyOwner, which compares _owner to _msgSender().
_feeAddrWallet1 is the hardcoded privileged address checked by manualswap.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the hardcoded privileged address checked by manualsend.
_transfer compares from/to against owner() to select fee and swap behaviour.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrease the spent allowance.
allowance() returns the value stored in _allowances.
_isExcludedFromFee gates the cooldown and sell-fee branches in _transfer.
bots mapping is asserted against from/to inside _transfer.
setBots writes true into the bots blacklist.
delBot writes false into the bots blacklist.
_transfer reads cooldown[to] and compares it with block.timestamp.
_transfer writes cooldown[to] from block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
swapEnabled gates the automatic liquidation inside _transfer.
inSwap flag is read in _transfer to prevent nested swaps.
_transfer calls balanceOf(address(this)) to size the swap.
contractTokenBalance local is assigned from balanceOf.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not inSwap.
lockTheSwap sets/clears inSwap around swapTokensForEth to block reentrancy.
swapTokensForEth toggles the inSwap reentrancy guard.
contractETHBalance local is assigned from address(this).balance.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
uniswapV2Router is used for WETH() and the swap call in swapTokensForEth.
The path array is built in swapTokensForEth and passed to the router.
swapTokensForEth approves the router to spend contract tokens.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap function.
sendETHToFee performs external ETH transfers to fee wallets.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the recipient of half of the contract ETH.
_feeAddrWallet2 is the recipient of the other half of the contract ETH.
ETH transfer can invoke the recipient's receive() fallback, re-entering the contract.
Router swap that returns ETH to the contract triggers receive().
Malicious token/router hooks during the swap could re-enter _transfer.
openTrading requires tradingOpen to be false.
openTrading assigns the Uniswap router address.
Local _uniswapV2Router is instantiated with the mainnet router address.
The local router drives pair creation, approvals and liquidity add.
openTrading calls factory().createPair to create the pair.
openTrading calls WETH()/factory() on the router.
openTrading adds ETH liquidity through the router.
openTrading grants an unlimited approval to the router for the pair.
openTrading stores the created pair in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading uses _tTotal for approvals and initial liquidity.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the WETH()/factory() calls.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
_takeTeam calls _getRate to scale the team portion.
MAX is used to compute _rTotal = MAX - (MAX % _tTotal), a reflection-supply arithmetic assumption.
_tTotal participates in the modulo arithmetic that derives _rTotal.
balanceOf converts _rOwned[account] into a token balance.
currentRate local is computed inside tokenFromReflection for the division.
to argument of _transfer, also the cooldown key.

_transferStandard.recipient is only meaningful inside _transferStandard.

_reflectFee.tFee is only meaningful inside _reflectFee.
_getValues.tAmount is only meaningful inside _getValues.
_getTValues.tAmount is only meaningful inside _getTValues.
_getTValues.taxFee is only meaningful inside _getTValues.
_getTValues.TeamFee is only meaningful inside _getTValues.

contractTokenBalance is a temporary snapshot consumed by swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is a temporary snapshot consumed by sendETHToFee.
